summary.prose: The build first teaches the import test about nested packages and cycles, so that new core code is checked from its first file. It then adds the failure type and checks, followed by the entry definitions and the checkpoint. Everything is new code except the import test and one docstring.

tasks.title: Extend the import test to nested packages and cycles
tasks.summary: In tests/test_architecture.py, key the allowed table by dotted package paths with the approved core entries and the existing embeddings entry, add the namespace rule, the core boundary rule and the module cycle check, and rewrite the example tables to match.
acceptanceChecks: A module belongs to the longest table key that prefixes its path
A module with no owning key is rejected unless it is a namespace __init__, and a namespace __init__ with code is rejected
A package under core importing outside core is rejected
A module import cycle is rejected and the modules are named
Dynamic importing is still rejected and the whole suite passes

tests.name: tests/test_architecture.py: the real source tree follows the table and has no module cycle
tests/test_architecture.py: examples reject core.common importing outside common and utils, an unlisted nested package, a namespace with code, a core package importing outside core and a module cycle
tests/test_architecture.py: allowed examples for nested packages are accepted

tasks.title: Add the shared failure type and the definition checks
tasks.summary: Create the core, core.common and core.utils packages with docstring-only __init__ files, the failures module and the validation module, with their tests.
acceptanceChecks: The seven failure kind values equal the contract strings and str of a failure is its message
A blank message or unknown kind raises ValueError or TypeError
Each check returns the value unchanged or raises an invalid_input Failure naming the field
A wrong type, a boolean or negative position, and a time without an offset are rejected; a time ending in Z is accepted
failures imports nothing from the project and validation imports only failures

tests.name: tests/test_failures.py: failure kind values equal the contract and a failure reads as its message
tests/test_failures.py: a blank message or unknown kind is a programming error
tests/test_validation.py: each check returns an accepted value unchanged
tests/test_validation.py: each check rejects an invalid value with an invalid_input failure naming the field

tasks.title: Add the entry definitions
tasks.summary: Add the entries module with EntryKind, EntryStatus, ProjectId, Source, Provenance, NamedEntity and Entry, its 500-character limit and retire, with the tests for the acceptance criteria.
acceptanceChecks: Entry kind and status values equal the contract strings
Empty kind or project, wrong types, empty sources and mismatched tags are rejected naming the field
Text of 501 characters is rejected and 500 is accepted; text is kept exactly
Tags after non-Latin text or emoji and a name tagged twice are accepted
retire changes the same entry once and records the time, with or without a replacement; a failed retire changes nothing
A retired entry needs a retirement time and may be created directly; an active entry has no time or replacement
Direct field assignment is rejected; entries compare by value before and after retirement and are not hashable
A source has only agent, session, file, position and time

tests.name: tests/test_entries.py: an entry with an empty kind raises an invalid_input failure naming kind
tests/test_entries.py: an entry with an empty project raises an invalid_input failure naming project
tests/test_entries.py: retire changes the same entry and records the time, with and without a replacement
tests/test_entries.py: retiring a retired entry fails and leaves it unchanged
tests/test_entries.py: retire with an invalid time fails and leaves the entry active
tests/test_entries.py: a retired entry needs a retirement time and an active entry has none
tests/test_entries.py: assigning a field of an entry directly is rejected
tests/test_entries.py: entry text with a negation, a scope and surrounding spaces is kept exactly
tests/test_entries.py: a source has only agent, session, file, position and time
tests/test_entries.py: text of 501 characters raises an invalid_input failure naming text and text of 500 is accepted
tests/test_entries.py: an entity that differs from the text at its positions raises an invalid_input failure naming entities
tests/test_entries.py: tags after non-Latin text or emoji and repeated names are accepted
tests/test_entries.py: wrong types and invalid source, provenance and project values are rejected naming the field
tests/test_entries.py: entry kind and status values equal the contract
tests/test_entries.py: entries compare by value and are not hashable

tasks.title: Add checkpoints and replace the stale package description
tasks.summary: Add the checkpoints module with its tests and replace the root package docstring with the current project description.
acceptanceChecks: A blank string, an invalid position or a time without an offset in a checkpoint is rejected naming the field
Position zero is accepted
The root docstring describes the current project
The whole suite passes with the real source tree following the table and having no cycle

tests.name: tests/test_checkpoints.py: a checkpoint accepts position zero
tests/test_checkpoints.py: an invalid checkpoint value is rejected naming the field
tests/test_architecture.py: the real source tree follows the table and has no module cycle
